title: Hearty Homemade Irish Corn Bowl
description: A delicious and satisfying Irish dish featuring creamed corn, perfect for a date night, served in a beautiful lacquerware bowl. This vegetarian-friendly recipe is sure to impress with its umami flavor and aerated texture.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the corn kernels for 5 minutes.
Drain the corn and set it aside to cool.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the cream simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the grated cheddar cheese until it is fully melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the blanched corn kernels, chopped scallions, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the cheese sauce.
Stir the mixture well to combine and let it heat through for 2 minutes.
Spoon the creamed corn mixture into a beautiful lacquerware bowl and serve hot.
